titel: Unraveling the story about George Santos' insider trading on Kalshi

einzeiler: How George Santos manipulated prediction markets and faced a permanent ban on Kalshi
kurzfassung: NPR tech correspondent Bobby Allen explains how he uncovered former Congressman George Santos's insider trading on the prediction market Kalshi. The investigation revealed that Santos bet against his own attendance at the State of the Union address while falsely claiming he would be there. Following the report, Santos threatened the journalist, and Kalshi ultimately issued a permanent ban against him.
stichpunkte: Kalshi permanently banned George Santos and fined him over $70,000 for insider trading.
Bobby Allen started investigating after receiving tips from Kalshi insiders about a former official.
Discord chatter among angry traders helped connect attendance market bets to Santos.
Santos called the journalist after the story broke and made a veiled violent threat.
Experienced colleagues advised Allen to make the threat public rather than keep it quiet.
Prediction markets face growing concerns about misinformation campaigns and election worker manipulation.
Federal regulators historically banned election betting due to risks of market manipulation.

clips.text: An internal source at the prediction platform provided initial hints about an investigation into a former elected official.

clips.hook: A hostile phone call from George Santos
clips.text: Immediately after publication, the former congressman placed an unannounced phone call featuring an aggressive tirade and a menacing statement.
Senior colleagues advised that harassment and intimidation by a former lawmaker against a reporter must be brought to light.

beschreibung:
This week, the popular prediction market known as Kalshi banned former Congressman George Santos for life and fined him more than 70-thousand dollars — after he engaged in insider trading on the site.

That came as no shock to NPR technology correspondent Bobby Allyn. Earlier this year, Allyn broke the story that Santos was under investigation by the Justice Department for manipulating the market about whether he would or would not attend this year’s State of the Union address.

For Reporter’s Notebook, Allyn talks about how he broke the story and the fallout from it.
